observation: Dual-lens independent review (Contract & Authority Reviewer vs. Test Adequacy & Mutation Reviewer) in WP-M3D-5 caught subtle, critical flaws that a single generic reviewer missed: a no-op assertion bug (len(res.FallbackReason) == 0), missing future-driver extensibility in the cross-portfolio verification matrix, and omitted budget exhaustion in the lifecycle test scenario.
proposed_change: Standardize the Dual-Lens Review Pack and require explicit Mutation Catalog Tables in docs/work-packages/IMPLEMENTATION_READY_TEMPLATE.md and docs/REVIEW_AND_CONVERGENCE.md for all implementation-ready EWPs.
expected_benefit: Dramatically increases defect detection precision on edge-case logic and negative-path assertions while eliminating single-reviewer blind spots and anchoring bias.
possible_counterexamples: Simple documentation-only or typo-fix EWPs do not require full dual mutation review; template already allows 'not applicable' declaration with recorded rationale.
evaluation_plan: Review findings and mutation kill rates across Window 2026-10-D EWPs to verify dual-lens catch rate and absence of undetected assertion bugs.
rollback_plan: Revert mandatory dual-lens requirement in EWP template back to single-reviewer optional configuration.
